log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Each day kill exactly 4 criminals: union-1 and union-2 as quick entries in the afternoon, and foreign-1 and foreign-2 as timed entries in the evening. Never kill more than 2 quick per day. With this pattern every routine has at most 2 deaths during its busy blocks, so timing reveals nothing. Worst-case info is union x foreign = 0.09, a pool of 900k, which stays above 300k even after police trimming. Never kill other sources or national: adding a third source risks dropping below 300k. Watch the press conferences; if a press conference signals new records, stay on this pattern.

Never kill a third source. If a press conference signals new records, keep this exact pattern.
